annotation_description_on_image: red numbers above lanes indicating mutant construct identity/quantified efficiency of 48S complex formation on AUG834
labels on the left indicating positions of initiation codons
label on the right indicating positions of assembled 48S complexes
dividing line/gap between sequence lanes (A,T,G,C) and numbered lanes (1-12)
from_the_caption: The efficiency of 48S complex formation on AUG834 (red numbers) was quantified taking the efficiency of complex formation on the wt EMCV IRES mRNA as 100%.
The positions of initiation codons are indicated on the left and of assembled 48S complexes on the right.
The positions of initiation codons are indicated on the left and of assembled 48S complexes on the right.
The division between sequence lanes and lanes 1–12 in (A) indicates that these two sets of lanes were derived from the same gel, exposed for different lengths of time.
